title: Battlepack section 10 — Action Groups

container.notes: Section 10 of battle_pack.bin (see container-battlepack). NOT st2e: u32 groupCount at +0, groupCount+1 u32 section-relative offsets from +4 (last = end of data before padding), zero padding to 16, then the groups back to back; each group is a run of 4-byte entries (u16 action, u16 chance); section zero-padded to 16. Groups are addressed by battle logic as 0x8000 | group index.

records.name: header
records.where: Offset 0 of battlepack section 10 (no st2e header).

fields.name: groupCount
fields.notes: Number of action groups; the offset table that follows has groupCount + 1 entries.

fields.name: offset
fields.notes: Section-relative start of group i. The last row is the end-of-data offset (end of the last group, before the final padding). Non-decreasing.

records.name: actionGroupEntry
records.where: group i occupies [groupOffset[i], groupOffset[i+1]) of the section; entries of all groups are stored back to back from groupOffset[0]

fields.name: chance
fields.notes: Chance / weight of picking this entry.

roundTrip: Unedited groups keep their entries and order; groups are never reordered (ids are positional).
groupOffset values are section-relative, non-decreasing, and the last one is the unpadded end of the data.
No padding between groups; header padded with zeros to 16 before group 0; section end padded with zeros to 16.
Editing action/chance in place needs no fix-up; any change in entry or group count requires recomputing every later groupOffset and the battlepack section offsets.
gaps: Semantics of chance (percent vs. relative weight; behaviour when the sum is not 100).
Whether action is always a section 14 action row or can also hold battle-logic ids (e.g. movement 0x4000+).
Vanilla groupCount and whether vanilla pads the header exactly to 16 before group 0.
Whether empty groups exist in vanilla.
